audience: sales teams that keep leads, contacts and deals in Close

useCases.title: Find a lead and its latest activity
useCases.text: Search leads by name, then open one to read its status and custom fields. List its activity timeline of notes, calls and emails.

useCases.title: Review pipelines and open deals
useCases.text: List the pipelines and their stages. List the opportunities, filtered by lead or status, to see the open deals.

useCases.title: Log a call note on a lead
useCases.text: Add a plain-text note to a lead's activity timeline, such as a call summary. This server has no tool to edit or delete a note.

useCases.title: Create a follow-up task
useCases.text: Create a task on a lead with a due date and an assignee. Close may email the assignee. Complete a task or reassign it later.

useCases.title: Move a deal to another stage
useCases.text: Change the status, value, likelihood or note of an opportunity. Only the fields you pass change.

useCases.title: Add a lead and its contact person
useCases.text: Create a lead, which is a company or an account. Then add a contact person to it.
